reasons.text: Energy charges do not match units x tariff on 100% of bills (worst bill charged 33% of expected)
47% of purchase invoices have suspiciously round tonnages (typical plant: about 2%)
100% of certificate tonnes were sold below the cost of recycling (average 0.22x the cost floor)
56% of high-value consignments have no e-way bill
Sold products equal only 32% of the output expected from the tonnes claimed
Declared capacity of 4,480 t/yr needs about 2.0x the power the plant is connected for

inspection_checklist: Verify the electricity bills directly with the DISCOM (units, tariff, amount); the uploaded copies do not reconcile.
Physically verify a sample of purchase invoices with the sellers (weighbridge slips, e-way bills, vehicle logs).
Ask for the plant's cost sheet; certificates priced below the cost of recycling imply the processing cost was never incurred.
Reconcile product sales with processed tonnes; contact the product buyers listed and verify that they received the material.
Obtain the DISCOM consumption statement and meter readings for the flagged months; compare connected machinery (kW) against the claimed tonnage.
